terms.meaning: a short text that teaches the assistant one method. The assistant reads it with read_skill.
a function that the assistant calls, such as search_collections.
one use of a tool with its arguments.
a named input value of a tool call.
a short label such as D1 or W2 that names one cited source in an answer.
words copied exactly from a source.
a file that the assistant writes for the user in the conversation.
a longer answer that the assistant writes into a workspace file.
a short part of the text of a document.
a page of a public website.
the work of the assistant for one user message.
a short message that the system adds to the conversation for the assistant.
the list of steps that the assistant keeps with update_plan.
